other_failure_modes.name: Overwriting test IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent drops the 'id' column from the test set (if present) without saving it, and constructs the submission file using a new sequence of IDs starting from 0. If the original test set IDs are not simply 0 to N-1, the submission will be misaligned with the expected format.

summary: The agent builds a technically functional pipeline using scaling, feature selection, and a weighted ensemble of tree-based models, but it critically fails to establish any validation framework. It iterates through cross-validation folds but ignores the validation indices, producing test predictions blindly with no internal metric to gauge success. Additionally, the submission generation blindly overwrites potential test IDs with a simple range, which risks complete submission failure if the actual IDs are non-sequential.
